_comment: Grandpa acknowledges the actual current party after this character returns with the Home Key following Stormwood. Names and recorded personal choices come from live personal state; actual starter choice requires its bound receipt. Existing creature history is not attributed to the current trainer.

regional_homecoming_0.speaker: Grandpa Elias
lines: You're home. Word reached us that the Dynamo has fallen quiet.
The road brought you far from this farm, and you found your own way home.
Come sit a minute. I'm glad you're here.
